That specific release confirms the $60.9 billion total for the cycle concluding on that date [7].

Consequently, based on the available source data regarding the fiscal year concluded in late January 2024, the total revenue is confirmed as $60.9 billion [2]. The sources consistently link this amount to the fiscal period ending January 28, 2024 [6]. No other conflicting total figures for this specific fiscal year are present in the provided texts; future projections and subsequent years' results are distinct from the requested FY24 data [1][5].

Therefore, the only verifiable number for Nvidia's total revenue in the fiscal year ended January 2024 is $60.9 billion [2].

In fiscal year 2023, Amazon's total net sales (revenue) were reported as $574.8 billion. [2] This figure represents a 12% increase from the $514.0 billion reported in 2022. [2], [4] Other sources confirm this amount as approximately $574.79 billion or $574.78 billion, noting an increase of roughly 11.83% to 12% over the prior year. [3], [9], [8]

The total net sales for 2023 are the sum of revenues from three primary segments: North America, International, and AWS (Amazon Web Services). The North America segment generated $352.8 billion in sales, which was a 12% year-over-year increase compared to 2022. [4] This specific figure is also cited as approximately $353 billion in one annual report summary. [8]

The International segment contributed $131.2 billion in net sales for the full year 2023. This represented an 11% increase from 2022, where international sales were $118 billion. [4], [8] Some sources round this figure slightly differently, listing it as $131 billion or noting a growth rate between 11% and 11.8%. [9]

The AWS segment reported net sales of $90.8 billion for fiscal year 2023, marking a 13% increase from the previous year. [4], [8] One summary document rounds this to $91 billion, consistent with the 13% growth trajectory starting from an estimated $80 billion in 2022. [8]

Additionally, during the fourth quarter of 2023 (ended December 31), net sales for the period reached $170.0 billion. This was a 14% increase from $149.2 billion in the same quarter of 2022. [2], [4], [10] When excluding the impact of foreign exchange rates, Q4 2023 net sales increased by 13%. [4] The fourth quarter accounted for a significant portion of the annual total, with AWS contributing approximately $59 billion in Q4 alone to reach its full-year high.

Data from SEC filings and financial releases consistently supports these figures, placing Amazon's FY2023 revenue at $574.78 billion or $574.8 billion depending on rounding conventions used in specific press releases versus XBRL data. [1], [9] These numbers reflect the consolidation of North American growth, international recovery, and strong AWS performance during the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023.

The total net sales figure excludes any favorable or unfavorable impacts from changes in foreign exchange rates unless specifically noted as adjusted figures. The reported $574.8 billion includes an unfavorable impact of $0.1 billion due to currency fluctuations compared to the prior year, meaning the underlying organic growth was slightly higher. [4]
